lure: A new friend's mentor made him thousands on a trading app
ask: Start with $500 on the mentor's app

message.body: It is easy. Start with $500 on my mentor's app, I will guide you step by step.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is the investment scam.
reasons: The profits shown are fake; the first deposit is never seen again.
The friendship started with a wrong number and moved to WhatsApp.
